title: The Role of Base Model Pretraining in Emergent Misalignment Susceptibility

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Identifying which pretraining property predicts misalignment susceptibility enables screening before deployment. Direct safety utility: practitioners can avoid deploying models with high-risk profiles.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: A 2x2x2 factorial design requires 8 separate fine-tuning runs across models of different sizes and types. Loading and fine-tuning 13B models may exceed medium compute. Managing 8 experimental conditions is logistically complex for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Eight experimental conditions is a large factorial design. Even with shared evaluation infrastructure, 8 fine-tuning runs plus evaluation exceeds 30 hours. Would need to reduce to a 2x2 design to be feasible.
